jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Principal Data Engineer

Location: Pune / Chennai (Hybrid)

Client is looking for an experienced Senior Principal Data Engineer to provide technical leadership in designing scalable data platforms and driving complex, cross-team initiatives for their cybersecurity platform. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in data engineering, cloud platforms, data architecture, and modern data technologies, along with the ability to mentor engineers and influence technical direction.

Key Responsibilities
• Lead architecture and development of scalable data engineering solutions across multiple domains.
• Drive complex cross-team projects and define technical strategies with engineering leadership.
• Own and enhance critical data platforms, services, and engineering practices.
• Evaluate and implement new technologies to improve data capabilities.
• Build and optimize data pipelines, data warehouses, and real-time processing systems.
• Collaborate with engineering teams and stakeholders to solve complex data challenges.
• Mentor engineers and contribute to coding standards, reviews, technical documentation, and best practices.
• Ensure quality engineering practices through code reviews, CI/CD processes, and production deployments.

Required Skills & Experience
• 6–10 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering within large-scale, high-volume environments.
• Strong expertise in SQL and Python (expert in one and strong understanding of the other).
• Extensive experience with Snowflake architecture, optimization, and performance tuning.
• Strong experience in Kimball dimensional modeling, data warehouses, and star schema architectures.
• Hands-on experience with AWS cloud infrastructure for data platforms.
• Experience with DBT or SQL Mesh for data transformation workflows.
• Strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, GitFlow/Trunk-based development, and data governance.
• Experience with Apache Kafka, event-driven architectures, and real-time analytics pipelines.
• Knowledge of Lakehouse architecture, Apache Iceberg, and modern data platforms.
• Understanding of data security, GDPR, and PCI-DSS compliance requirements.
• Ability to independently architect solutions and drive technical initiatives.

Preferred Experience
• Experience working in cybersecurity, fintech, ad-tech, or other high-volume data environments.
• Experience with subscription analytics, cohort analysis, LTV calculations, churn prediction, or behavioral analytics.
• Experience building executive reporting and complex analytics solutions.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Analyst - 2
jobs.description:
Role: Cyber Security Analyst - 2

Location: Bangalore

Department: Platform Engineering / Security

Experience: 3–8 Years

About Styli Marketplace

Launched in 2019 by Landmark Group, Styli Marketplace is the first e-commerce venture of the group, quickly becoming a leading online destination for fashion and lifestyle across the GCC, including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, and beyond. Styli connects global sellers and creators with millions of fashion-forward customers, offering the latest trends, exceptional value, and convenient services like same-day to 48-hour delivery and flexible payment options. Our mission is to make style accessible, aspirational, and exciting for all, backed by a passionate team fostering a culture of creativity and innovation. At Styli, we aim to revolutionize fashion retail and bring unique experiences to our customers.

Role Overview

We are looking for a driven and hands-on Cybersecurity Engineer to join our security engineering team. You will be responsible for protecting Styli's digital infrastructure, customer data, and application ecosystem against evolving threats. This is a high-impact role where you will work across AppSec, cloud security, and SecOps to build security capabilities that scale with our growth.

What You'll Do

Application & Product Security
• Conduct threat modelling, security design reviews, and code-level security assessments for new features and product releases.
• Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA tools into CI/CD pipelines to shift security left.
• Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing of web and mobile applications (Android/iOS).
• Partner with engineering teams to remediate findings and track closure SLAs.

Cloud & Infrastructure Security
• Secure cloud environments (AWS / GCP) including IAM hardening, VPC configurations, S3 bucket policies, and secrets management.
• Implement and maintain container security controls — image scanning, runtime protection, Kubernetes policy enforcement (OPA/Kyverno).
• Define and audit Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) for security misconfigurations using tools like Checkov or tfsec.

Security Operations & Incident Response
• Monitor SIEM and alerting pipelines; triage, investigate, and respond to security incidents.
• Develop detection rules and playbooks to reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and respond (MTTR).
• Conduct post-incident reviews and drive root cause analysis with actionable hardening recommendations.

Compliance & Risk
• Support various data privacy compliance programs relevant to e-commerce operations.
• Conduct vendor and third-party security assessments.
• Maintain security documentation, risk registers, and evidence artifacts for audits.

What We're Looking For

Required
• 3–8 years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity engineering or related roles.
• Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, common web vulnerabilities (SQLi, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, etc.), and secure coding practices.
• Experience securing cloud environments — AWS or GCP. Preferably GCP.
• Hands-on experience with security tooling: Burp Suite, Nessus/Qualys, Trivy, Snyk, SonarQube, or equivalents.
• Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python, Bash, or Go — for automation and tooling.
• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, HTTP/S, firewalls, proxies.
• Experience integrating security into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).

Good to Have
• Experience with bug bounty programs (HackerOne / Bugcrowd) — either as a participant or a program operator.
• Familiarity with API security (REST, GraphQL) in high-traffic e-commerce or fintech environments.
• Knowledge of container and Kubernetes security hardening.
• Relevant certifications: CEH, OSCP, AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, or CompTIA Security+.
• Prior experience in e-commerce, fintech, or payments-adjacent environments.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Professional
jobs.description:
Job Title: Cybersecurity Professional

Job Location: Anywhere in India

Role Overview:

As a Product and Solution Security Expert (PSSE) in Grid Software, you are the cybersecurity backbone for mission-critical Operational Technology (OT) deployments. You will act as the trusted security authority interfacing between our R&D organizations, project engineering teams, and major transmission/distribution system operators (TSOs/DSOs).

Your mission is to secure our advanced SCADA, ADMS, and grid automation solutions against evolving threat landscapes without compromising the strict availability and real-time performance demands of critical infrastructure. You will champion our security posture—safeguarding legacy integration layers while driving robust, secure architectures for modern deployments.

Key Responsibilities:

• Customer & Stakeholder Cybersecurity Leadership: Serve as the primary security interface for high-stakes customer projects, leading security alignment workshops, architecture reviews, and defending our security posture against rigorous customer specifications and regulatory frameworks (e.g., NIS2, IEC 62443).
• Secure Architecture & Integration: Oversee the secure design, hardening, and network segmentation of SCADA/EMS solutions deployed in customer environments. Ensure seamless integration of identity and access management (IAM), secure logging, and patch management workflows.
• Risk & Vulnerability Management: Apply our post-freeze risk scorecard methodologies. Evaluate 3rd-party software vulnerabilities using Environmental CVSS, reachability analysis (VEX), and exploit probability (EPSS/KEV) to advise Project Managers and Product Security Officers (PSSOs) on risk-based release decisions.
• Compliance & Certification Support: Drive adherence to IEC 62443-3-3 standards across project lifecycles, preparing documentation, security targets, and evidence for customer audits and factory/site acceptance tests (FAT/SAT).
• Incident Preparedness & Incident Engineering: Collaborate with project teams and incident response units to define fail-open contingency designs, ensuring grid availability takes precedence while containment and remediation occur safely.

Key Deliverables:

• Project Security Architecture & Risk Assessments: Comprehensive security design documents, threat models (STRIDE), and system-specific risk assessments for every assigned critical infrastructure project.
• Security-Gate Sign-offs: Authoritative security reviews and gate approvals at key project milestones (Architecture, FAT, SAT, Go-Live), backed by quantified risk-mitigation plans.
• Vulnerability & Patch Management Runbooks: Tailored operational guidelines and risk-scoring rationales for customers handling 3rd-party component patching in live SCADA environments.
• Regulatory & Audit Artifacts: Audit-ready compliance packages mapping project implementations to IEC 62443 and national critical infrastructure protection (CIP) standards.

What Success Looks Like:

• Zero Unmitigated Critical Exposures: High-risk vulnerabilities and architectural gaps are identified, triaged, and mitigated proactively before system integration or customer sign-off.
• Trusted Advisor Status: You earn the absolute confidence of customer CISOs and Bid- and Project Managers by explaining complex OT cybersecurity trade-offs with clarity, pragmatism, and authority.
• Resilient Delivery Without Compromise: Grid availability and performance are never sacrificed; your security frameworks ensure that fail-open mechanisms and robust risk management protect the grid while maintaining operational uptime.
• Seamless Collaboration: Engineering teams, PSSOs, and external partners view you not as a compliance bottleneck, but as an enabler who embeds security cleanly into the delivery lifecycle.

Qualifications:

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity within Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, or critical infrastructure sectors.
• Deep working knowledge of IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and European cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NIS2, CRA).
• Hands-on experience with threat modeling, secure network architectures (Purdue Model, firewalls, datadiodes), Identiy and Access Management concepts and vulnerability triaging tools.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English

jobs.title: Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Company: Foresee Security (NMT Security Innovations Pvt. Ltd.)

Location: Noida, India (On-site)

Experience: 3–5 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Open Positions: 1

Joining: Immediate / Short Notice Preferred

Compensation: As per market standards

Certifications: CEH + One Hands-on Certification (Mandatory)

About Foresee Security

Foresee Security is an AI-powered cyber risk decision intelligence platform helping organizations identify, connect, and prioritize cybersecurity risks.

Our unified platform brings together External Exposure Intelligence, Third-Party Risk Intelligence, Continuous Compliance Intelligence, and AI Governance to help enterprises proactively manage cybersecurity risks and make smarter security decisions.

Website: www.foreseesecurity.io

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on VAPT Specialist to join our cybersecurity team.

This role combines client-facing penetration testing engagements with security research, vulnerability validation, and detection engineering for our External Attack Surface Intelligence platform.

The selected candidate will spend approximately 60% of their time on client VAPT engagements and 40% on product security validation and development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Penetration Testing & Client Delivery (60%)
• Independently plan and execute VAPT engagements for web applications, APIs, mobile applications (Android/iOS), networks, and cloud environments.
• Perform AI/LLM application security testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, RAG data leakage, and agent/tool abuse.
• Identify and validate vulnerabilities such as IDOR, broken access control, authentication bypass, business logic flaws, and chained exploits.
• Conduct manual penetration testing beyond automated vulnerability scanning.
• Prepare comprehensive VAPT reports with risk ratings, proof of concept, business impact, and remediation recommendations.
• Conduct retesting and work with client teams to validate remediation.
• Support security assessments aligned with OWASP, RBI, SEBI, CERT-In, and ISO 27001 requirements.

2. External Attack Surface Intelligence (40%)
• Validate vulnerabilities and security exposures identified by the Foresee Security platform.
• Identify false positives and false negatives to improve detection accuracy.
• Perform attack surface discovery using Amass, Subfinder, httpx, Nuclei, Shodan, and Censys.
• Develop Nuclei templates, Python scripts, and automated vulnerability detection checks.
• Translate manual security research findings into scalable detection capabilities.
• Collaborate with engineering and product teams to improve the platform's security intelligence.

Required Technical Skills
• 3–5 years of hands-on penetration testing experience.
• At least 2 years of independently delivering client VAPT engagements.
• Strong manual web application and API penetration testing skills.
• Proficiency in Burp Suite Professional, Nmap, Metasploit, and Nuclei.
• Experience in network reconnaissance, DNS enumeration, service fingerprinting, and vulnerability validation.
• Practical knowledge of cloud security assessments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
• Understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP MASVS, and CVSS.
• Working knowledge of Python or Bash scripting.
• Knowledge of AI/LLM security vulnerabilities and testing methodologies.
• Strong technical documentation, reporting, and client communication skills.

Mandatory Certifications

Candidates must hold both:
• Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) – Mandatory
• At least one hands-on certification: OSCP, OSWE, eWPTX, CRTP, or CPTS.

Applications without CEH certification will not be considered.

Good to Have
• Hands-on LLM security testing using Garak, PyRIT, or Promptfoo.
• Experience developing custom Nuclei templates.
• Experience working with EASM or vulnerability management platforms.
• Bug bounty achievements, CVE discoveries, or published security research.
• Mobile security testing using Frida, Objection, or MobSF.
• Experience with RBI, SEBI, or financial-sector cybersecurity assessments.

Why Join Foresee Security?
• Work on an AI-powered cybersecurity product used for enterprise risk intelligence.
• Combine offensive security research with real-world product development.
• Contribute to vulnerability detection and security automation capabilities.
• Work on diverse enterprise penetration testing engagements.
• Collaborate directly with the founding, product, and engineering teams.
• Opportunity to grow into advanced offensive security and security research roles.

Hiring Process
• Initial profile and certification screening.
• Technical screening interview.
• Hands-on penetration testing assessment, including an AI/LLM security exercise.
• Final technical and founder interview.

Foresee Security

One Platform. Connected Risks. Smarter Decisions.
